parsed.rationale: One of the two participating records lives at 'Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift', which sits under the 'Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/' directory — a canonical sample-app location that triggers the sample-app-mirror restraint regardless of the is_sample_app flag value. The production copy in 'Shared/DebugPanel/Sources/DebugPanel/DebugMetricsProvider.swift' (package: DebugPanel) is the authoritative implementation; the WallpaperSampleApp copy is a deliberate local mirror for demonstration purposes. Extracting a shared implementation would couple the DebugPanel production package to sample-app semantics, which is the canonical anti-pattern the restraint rule is designed to prevent.
